80.example: The sunglasses use a polaroid filter to reduce glare from the sun.

80.english_meaning: Passed or sent through a medium or space.
80.hindi_meaning: किसी माध्यम से होकर गुजरने वाला या प्रेषित किया गया।
80.example: The intensity of the transmitted light decreased as the polaroids were rotated.

80.english_meaning: Regular movements back and forth between two points.
80.hindi_meaning: दो बिंदुओं के बीच होने वाली नियमित गति या दोलन।
80.example: The double arrows in the diagram represent the oscillations of the electric vector.

80.english_meaning: The measurable amount of a property, such as force, brightness, or energy per unit area.
80.hindi_meaning: किसी भौतिक गुण (जैसे प्रकाश या ऊर्जा) की प्रबलता या तीव्रता।
80.example: The intensity of the light beam can be controlled by adjusting the polaroid angle.

80.english_meaning: Falling or striking upon a surface (referring to light or radiation).
80.hindi_meaning: किसी सतह पर आपतित होने वाली (प्रकाश किरणें)।
80.example: The incident intensity is the amount of light hitting the first polaroid.

80.english_meaning: The process of restricting the vibrations of light waves to a single plane.
80.hindi_meaning: प्रकाश तरंगों के कंपनों को एक ही तल में सीमित करने की प्रक्रिया (ध्रुवण)।
80.example: Polarisation is a fundamental property of light waves in wave optics.

80.english_meaning: A part or element of a larger whole.
80.hindi_meaning: किसी बड़ी वस्तु का एक भाग या घटक।
80.example: The electric vector has a component parallel to the polaroid axis.

80.english_meaning: Making small changes to something to improve its fit or performance.
80.hindi_meaning: किसी चीज़ को बेहतर बनाने या सही स्थिति में लाने के लिए उसमें थोड़ा बदलाव करना (समायोजन)।
80.example: By adjusting the angle, we can control the brightness of the light.

80.english_meaning: A quantity having direction as well as magnitude.
80.hindi_meaning: एक ऐसी राशि जिसमें परिमाण के साथ-साथ दिशा भी होती है (सदिश)।
80.example: The electric vector represents the direction of the electric field in light.

80.english_meaning: Side by side and having the same distance continuously between them.
80.hindi_meaning: समानांतर, जो कभी एक-दूसरे को न काटें।
80.example: The transmitted light is parallel to the axis of the polaroid.

80.english_meaning: Coming out of or becoming apparent.
80.example: The light emerging from the second polaroid is much dimmer.

80.english_meaning: Placed at right angles to each other.
80.hindi_meaning: एक-दूसरे के लंबवत या विपरीत दिशा में रखे गए।
80.example: When two polaroids are crossed, no light can pass through them.

80.english_meaning: A small part or amount of something.
80.hindi_meaning: किसी चीज़ का एक छोटा हिस्सा या अंश।
80.example: Only a fraction of the incident light is transmitted through the filter.

80.english_meaning: An imaginary line about which a body rotates or a reference line for measurement.
80.hindi_meaning: अक्ष, वह काल्पनिक रेखा जिसके चारों ओर कोई वस्तु घूमती है या मापन के लिए आधार रेखा।
80.example: The pass-axis of the polaroid determines which light waves can pass.

80.english_meaning: To talk or write about a topic in detail.
80.hindi_meaning: किसी विषय पर विस्तार से चर्चा करना या विश्लेषण करना।
80.example: We need to discuss the intensity changes in the given physics problem.

81.english_meaning: The combination of two or more overlapping waves resulting in a new wave pattern of greater or lower amplitude.
81.hindi_meaning: व्यतिकरण (दो या दो से अधिक तरंगों के मिलने से बनने वाला नया प्रभाव)
81.example: The interference of light waves produces bright and dark bands on the screen.

81.english_meaning: The bending of waves around obstacles and openings relative to their wavelength.
81.hindi_meaning: विवर्तन (तरंगों का किसी अवरोध या किनारे से मुड़ना)
81.example: Diffraction explains why light bends slightly around the edges of an obstacle.

81.english_meaning: A property applying to transverse waves that specifies the geometrical orientation of the oscillations.
81.hindi_meaning: ध्रुवीकरण (अनुप्रस्थ तरंगों के कंपनों को एक निश्चित दिशा में सीमित करना)
81.example: Sunglasses use polaroid filters to reduce glare through polarisation.

81.english_meaning: The locus of all adjacent points having the same phase of vibration at a given time.
81.hindi_meaning: तरंगाग्र (समान कला में कंपन करने वाले बिंदुओं का लोकस)
81.example: Huygens' principle states that every point on a wavefront acts as a source of secondary ripples.

81.english_meaning: The principle that the net response at a given place and time caused by two or more stimuli is the sum of the responses which would have been caused by each stimulus individually.
81.hindi_meaning: अध्यारोपण (दो या दो से अधिक तरंगों का एक ही बिंदु पर मिलना)
81.example: The principle of superposition is fundamental to understanding wave interference.

81.english_meaning: Having vibrations perpendicular to the direction of energy transfer.
81.hindi_meaning: अनुप्रस्थ (जिसमें कंपन तरंग की दिशा के लंबवत होते हैं)
81.example: Light waves are transverse waves, unlike sound waves in air.

81.english_meaning: Having vibrations parallel to the direction of wave propagation.
81.hindi_meaning: अनुदैर्ध्य (जिसमें कंपन तरंग की दिशा के समांतर होते हैं)
81.example: Sound waves in air are classic examples of longitudinal waves.

81.english_meaning: Alternative bright and dark bands produced by interference or diffraction of light.
81.hindi_meaning: फ्रिंज (व्यतिकरण या विवर्तन के कारण बनने वाली चमकीली और अंधेरी पटियाँ)
81.example: Young’s double-slit experiment displays equally spaced interference fringes.

81.english_meaning: Consisting of waves that have vibrations in all directions perpendicular to the direction of travel.
81.hindi_meaning: अध्रुवित (जिसमें कंपन सभी दिशाओं में होते हैं)
81.example: Natural light coming directly from the sun is completely unpolarised.

81.english_meaning: The maximum extent of a vibration or oscillation, measured from the position of equilibrium.
81.example: Constructive interference occurs when wave amplitudes reinforce each other.

81.english_meaning: The distance between successive crests of a wave.
81.hindi_meaning: तरंगदैर्ध्य (दो क्रमागत शिखरों या गर्तों के बीच की दूरी)
81.example: The resolving power of a microscope is limited by the wavelength of light used.

81.english_meaning: The bending of a wave as it passes from one medium to another due to a change in its speed.
81.hindi_meaning: अपवर्तन (तरंगों का एक माध्यम से दूसरे माध्यम में जाने पर मुड़ना)
81.example: Huygens' construction successfully derives the standard laws of reflection and refraction.

81.english_meaning: The power transferred by a wave per unit area.
81.hindi_meaning: तीव्रता (प्रति इकाई क्षेत्रफल में प्रवाहित ऊर्जा)
81.example: The intensity of light falls to zero at specific angles in a single-slit diffraction pattern.

81.english_meaning: Relating to interference that results in an increased wave amplitude.
81.hindi_meaning: संपोषी (व्यतिकरण जो आयाम को बढ़ाता है)
81.example: Constructive interference creates bright regions in an interference pattern.

81.english_meaning: Relating to interference that results in a decreased or zero wave amplitude.
81.hindi_meaning: विनाशी (व्यतिकरण जो आयाम को घटाता या शून्य करता है)
81.example: Destructive interference leads to dark fringes where waves cancel each other out.

82.english_meaning: Consisting of or having a single color or wavelength.
82.hindi_meaning: एकवर्ण (एक ही रंग या तरंगदैर्ध्य वाला)
82.example: Monochromatic light of wavelength 589 nm is incident from air on a water surface.

82.english_meaning: The distance between successive crests of a wave, especially points in a sound wave or electromagnetic wave.
82.example: What are the wavelength, frequency and speed of the reflected and refracted light?

82.english_meaning: Deflected from a straight path when passing obliquely from one medium into another of different density.
82.hindi_meaning: अपवर्तित (प्रकाश या अन्य तरंगों का मुड़ना)
82.example: Find the properties of the refracted light entering the water surface.

82.english_meaning: A measure of the bending of a ray of light when passing from one medium into another.
A surface containing points executing the same phase of vibration in a wave.

82.english_meaning: Tending to be different or to move away from each other from a common point.
82.hindi_meaning: अपसारे (फैलावदार, एक बिंदु से बाहर की ओर फैलना)
82.example: Light diverging from a point source creates a spherical wavefront.

82.english_meaning: A lens that curves outward and converges light rays passing through it.
82.example: Light emerging out of a convex lens when a point source is placed at its focus.

82.english_meaning: Obstructed or stopped someone or something from continuing to a destination.
82.example: The portion of the wavefront of light from a distant star intercepted by the Earth.

82.english_meaning: A space entirely devoid of matter.
82.example: Speed of light in vacuum is 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹.

82.english_meaning: A transparent optical element with flat, polished surfaces that refract light.
82.example: Which of the two colours red and violet travels slower in a glass prism?

82.english_meaning: The combination of two or more electromagnetic waveforms to form a resultant wave in which the displacement is either reinforced or cancelled.
82.example: A beam of light is used to obtain interference fringes in a Young’s double-slit experiment.

82.english_meaning: A bright or dark band caused by the diffraction or interference of light.
82.hindi_meaning: फ्रिंज (व्यतिकरण पैटर्न की चमकीली या अंधेरी पट्टी)
82.example: The distance between the central bright fringe and the fourth bright fringe is measured.

82.english_meaning: The measurable amount of a property, such as force, brightness, or a magnetic field.
82.example: The intensity of light at a point on the screen where path difference is l, is K units.

82.english_meaning: Occur at or during the same time; to occupy the same exact space or position.
82.hindi_meaning: संपाती होना (एक ही बिंदु या समय पर मिलना)
82.example: What is the least distance where the bright fringes due to both the wavelengths coincide?

82.english_meaning: The difference in the distance traveled by two waves from their respective sources to a given point.
82.hindi_meaning: पथान्तर (दो तरंगों द्वारा तय किए गए रास्तों का अंतर)
82.example: At a point on the screen where path difference is l/3, calculate the intensity.

83.english_meaning: Relating to the interrelationship of electric and magnetic fields or waves.

83.hindi_meaning: मील का पत्थर या महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि
83.example: The discovery of the electron was a major milestone in physics.

83.english_meaning: The structure of an atom, consisting of a nucleus and electrons.
83.example: These discoveries helped scientists understand atomic structure better.

84.english_meaning: A beam of electrons emitted from the cathode of a high-vacuum tube.
84.hindi_meaning: कैथोड किरण - उच्च निर्वात नली के कैथोड से उत्सर्जित होने वाली इलेक्ट्रॉनों की किरण।

84.english_meaning: The quality or state of being universal or applicable everywhere.

84.example: This observation suggested the universality of the cathode ray particles across different materials.

84.english_meaning: Exposed to radiation, especially ultraviolet or ionizing radiation.
84.hindi_meaning: विकिरणित - किसी वस्तु को विकिरण (विशेषकर पराबैंगनी किरणों) के संपर्क में लाना।

84.english_meaning: Extremely important; marking the beginning of a new historic period or era.
84.hindi_meaning: युगांतकारी - अत्यधिक महत्वपूर्ण या इतिहास में एक नए युग की शुरुआत करने वाला।
84.example: He was awarded the Nobel Prize for his epoch-making discovery of the electron.

84.english_meaning: Following as a result or effect.

84.hindi_meaning: कार्य फलन - किसी धातु की सतह से इलेक्ट्रॉन को बाहर निकालने के लिए आवश्यक न्यूनतम ऊर्जा।

84.english_meaning: The difference in electric potential between two points, measured in volts.
84.hindi_meaning: विभवांतर - दो बिंदुओं के बीच विद्युत विभव का अंतर, जिसे वोल्ट में मापा जाता है।
84.example: One electron volt is the energy gained by an electron accelerated by a potential difference of 1 volt.

84.english_meaning: The branch of physics that studies atoms as an isolated system of electrons and an atomic nucleus.
84.hindi_meaning: परमाणु भौतिकी - भौतिकी की वह शाखा जिसमें परमाणुओं और उनके घटकों का अध्ययन किया जाता है।
84.example: This unit of energy is commonly used in atomic and nuclear physics.

84.english_meaning: The thermal emission of charge particles from a heated metal surface.
84.hindi_meaning: तापायनिक उत्सर्जन - गर्म धातु की सतह से आवेशित कणों (इलेक्ट्रॉनों) का térmica ऊर्जा द्वारा बाहर निकलना।
84.example: In thermionic emission, sufficient thermal energy is imparted to the free electrons by heating.

84.hindi_meaning: प्रदान करना या देना - किसी वस्तु में ऊर्जा या गुण का संचार करना।
84.example: Sufficient thermal energy can be imparted to the free electrons to enable them to come out.

84.english_meaning: The action of investigating something or a formal inquiry.
84.hindi_meaning: अन्वेषण या जाँच - किसी विषय पर वैज्ञानिक या औपचारिक रूप से की गई खोजबीन।
84.example: Through his theoretical and experimental investigations, J. J. Thomson discovered the electron.

85.english_meaning: The emission of electrons from the surface of a metal by applying a very strong electric field.
85.hindi_meaning: क्षेत्र उत्सर्जन (धातु पर प्रबल विद्युत क्षेत्र लगाकर उससे इलेक्ट्रॉन बाहर निकालना)

85.hindi_meaning: प्रकाश-वैद्युत उत्सर्जन (उपयुक्त आवृत्ति का प्रकाश पड़ने पर धातु की सतह से इलेक्ट्रॉनों का निकलना)
85.example: Photoelectric emission is the process where light causes electrons to escape from a metal.

85.english_meaning: Electrons emitted from a metal surface as a result of light falling on it.
85.hindi_meaning: प्रकाश-इलेक्ट्रॉन (प्रकाश के कारण धातु की सतह से उत्सर्जित होने वाले इलेक्ट्रॉन)
85.example: The light-generated electrons are called photoelectrons.

85.english_meaning: To shine light upon a surface or object.

85.english_meaning: Relating to the interrelationship of electric and magnetic fields or waves.
85.example: Heinrich Hertz discovered photoelectric emission during his electromagnetic wave experiments.

85.english_meaning: The release or flow of electricity from a charged body.
85.hindi_meaning: विसर्जन (विद्युत का निकलना या प्रवाहित होना)
85.example: High voltage sparks were produced by means of a spark discharge.

85.english_meaning: Increased or improved in quality, value, or intensity.
85.hindi_meaning: बढ़ाया गया या अधिक तीव्र किया गया
85.example: High voltage sparks across the detector loop were enhanced by ultraviolet light.

85.english_meaning: Made an action or process easier or more likely to happen.
85.example: Light shining on the metal surface facilitated the escape of free electrons.

85.english_meaning: Falling or striking upon a surface (referring to radiation or light).
85.hindi_meaning: आपतित (सतह पर पड़ने वाला प्रकाश या विकिरण)
85.example: Electrons absorb energy from the incident radiation.

85.english_meaning: Having had the air or gas removed from it; empty of air.
85.hindi_meaning: वायु-शूनित (जिसकी हवा या गैस निकाल दी गई हो)
85.example: The ultraviolet radiations fell on the emitter plate of an evacuated glass tube.

85.english_meaning: Conductors through which electricity enters or leaves an object or substance.
85.hindi_meaning: इलेक्ट्रोड (चालक प्लेटें जिनके माध्यम से विद्युत प्रवाहित होती है)
85.example: The glass tube encloses two electrodes, namely an emitter and a collector.

85.english_meaning: Forced or thrown out, typically with suddenness or force.
85.hindi_meaning: बाहर निकाला गया या उत्सर्जित किया गया
85.example: Electrons are ejected from the emitter plate when ultraviolet light falls on it.

85.english_meaning: An instrument used to detect the presence and magnitude of electric charge on a body.
85.hindi_meaning: विद्युतदर्शी (आवेश का पता लगाने वाला उपकरण)

85.english_meaning: Exposed to radiation, especially ultraviolet light.
85.hindi_meaning: विकिरणित करना (प्रकाश या किरणों से प्रदीप्त करना)
85.example: The uncharged zinc plate became positively charged when it was irradiated by ultraviolet light.

85.english_meaning: Plain or clear to the sight or understanding.

116.hindi_meaning: द्रव्यमान स्पेक्ट्रोमीटर (परमाणुओं का द्रव्यमान मापने वाला यंत्र)
116.example: An accurate measurement of atomic masses is carried out with a mass spectrometer.

116.english_meaning: A measure of the percentage of a specific isotope present in a naturally occurring sample of an element.
116.hindi_meaning: आपेक्षिक बहुलता (प्रकृति में किसी समस्थानिक की प्रतिशत मात्रा)
116.example: The relative abundance of different isotopes varies significantly from element to element.

116.english_meaning: An average calculated by multiplying each value by a factor reflecting its importance or frequency of occurrence.
116.example: The average atomic mass of chlorine is calculated using the weighted average of its isotopes.

116.english_meaning: A stable isotope of hydrogen with a mass approximately double that of ordinary hydrogen, containing one neutron in its nucleus.
116.example: Deuterium and tritium are the heavier isotopes of hydrogen.

116.english_meaning: A radioactive isotope of hydrogen with a nucleus containing one proton and two neutrons, produced artificially in laboratories.
116.example: Tritium nuclei are unstable and do not occur naturally in significant amounts.

116.english_meaning: Prone to radioactive decay or change; not permanent or fixed.
116.hindi_meaning: अस्थाई (रेडियोएक्टिव रूप से क्षय होने योग्य)
116.example: Unstable atomic nuclei tend to emit radiation to achieve stability.

116.english_meaning: Produced by human art or effort rather than occurring naturally.
116.example: Certain elements and isotopes are produced artificially in research laboratories.

116.english_meaning: A stable subatomic particle occurring in all atomic nuclei, with a positive electric charge equal in magnitude to that of an electron.
116.example: The nucleus of a hydrogen atom consists of a single proton.

116.english_meaning: The elementary electric charge, equal to the electric charge carried by a single proton.
116.example: A proton carries one unit of fundamental positive charge.

116.english_meaning: A theoretical basis of modern physics that explains the nature and behavior of matter and energy on the atomic and subatomic level.
116.example: Arguments based on quantum theory ruled out the presence of electrons inside the nucleus.

116.english_meaning: The number of protons in the nucleus of an atom, which determines the chemical properties of the element and its place in the periodic table.
116.example: The number of electrons outside the nucleus of a neutral atom is equal to its atomic number Z.

116.english_meaning: The result of multiplying a quantity by an integer (whole number).
116.example: Most atomic masses are close to being integral multiples of the mass of a hydrogen atom.

117.english_meaning: The number of protons in the nucleus of an atom, which determines the chemical properties of an element.
117.hindi_meaning: परमाणु क्रमांक (किसी परमाणु के नाभिक में मौजूद प्रोटॉनों की संख्या)
117.example: The atomic number of hydrogen is one, meaning it has one proton.

117.english_meaning: Forms of an element having the same atomic number but different mass numbers due to a different number of neutrons.
117.hindi_meaning: समस्थानिक (एक ही तत्व के परमाणु जिनके नाभिक में न्यूट्रॉनों की संख्या भिन्न होती है)
117.example: Deuterium and tritium are isotopes of hydrogen.

117.english_meaning: Having no net electrical charge; neither positive nor negative.
117.hindi_meaning: उदासीन (जिस पर कोई आवेश न हो)
117.example: An atom is electrically neutral because it has equal numbers of protons and electrons.

117.english_meaning: A proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation.
117.hindi_meaning: परिकल्पना (किसी बात को समझाने के लिए दिया गया शुरुआती अनुमान)
117.example: The scientist tested her hypothesis through a series of rigorous experiments.

117.english_meaning: Subjected a target to a stream of high-energy particles or radiation.
117.hindi_meaning: बमबारी करना (कणों या विकिरणों की बौछार करना)
117.example: Beryllium nuclei were bombarded with alpha-particles during the experiment.

117.english_meaning: The emission of energy as electromagnetic waves or as moving subatomic particles.
117.hindi_meaning: विकिरण (ऊर्जा या कणों का तरंगों के रूप में उत्सर्जन)
117.example: The emission of neutral radiation was observed when beryllium was struck by alpha particles.

117.english_meaning: A quantum of light or other electromagnetic radiation, carrying a specific amount of energy.
117.hindi_meaning: फोटॉन (प्रकाश या विद्युत चुम्बकीय विकिरण का मूल कण)
117.example: Light is composed of tiny packets of energy called photons.

117.english_meaning: The principle that the total measurable property in an isolated physical system remains constant over time.
117.hindi_meaning: संरक्षण (भौतिकी में किसी राशि का नियत रहना)
117.example: The laws of conservation of energy and momentum are fundamental in physics.

117.english_meaning: The quantity of motion of a moving body, measured as a product of its mass and velocity.
117.example: According to the principle of conservation, total momentum before and after a collision remains the same.

117.english_meaning: Prone to radioactive decay or chemical change; not physically stable.
117.hindi_meaning: अस्थिर (जो आसानी से विघटित हो जाए)
117.example: A free neutron is unstable and decays into a proton, an electron, and an antineutrino.

117.english_meaning: Undergoes radioactive disintegration, transforming into other subatomic particles.
117.example: An unstable atomic nucleus decays over time by emitting radiation.

117.english_meaning: A subatomic particle with no known substructure, meaning it is not made of smaller particles.
117.hindi_meaning: मूल कण (ऐसा कण जिसकी कोई छोटी संरचना न हो)
117.example: An electron and an antineutrino are examples of elementary particles.

117.english_meaning: A proton or a neutron, considered in its role as a component of an atomic nucleus.
117.hindi_meaning: नुक्य्लॉन (प्रोटॉन या न्यूट्रॉन, जो नाभिक का हिस्सा होते हैं)
117.example: The total number of nucleons in a nucleus is called its mass number.

117.english_meaning: A distinct kind of atom or nucleus characterized by a specific number of protons and neutrons.
117.hindi_meaning: नूक्लाइड (एक विशिष्ट परमाणु प्रजाति जिसमें निश्चित प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन हों)
117.example: Different nuclear species or nuclides are represented using chemical symbols along with their mass and atomic numbers.

117.english_meaning: A system of written symbols used to represent numbers, amounts, or elements in science and mathematics.
117.example: Scientific notation helps represent very large or very small numbers easily.

118.english_meaning: Plural form of nucleus, the dense center of an atom made of protons and neutrons.
118.example: The nuclei of isotopes contain the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.

118.english_meaning: Variants of a chemical element that have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
118.example: Deuterium and tritium are well-known isotopes of hydrogen.

118.english_meaning: A stable isotope of hydrogen containing one proton and one neutron.
118.example: Deuterium is an isotope of hydrogen with one proton and one neutron.

118.english_meaning: A radioactive isotope of hydrogen containing one proton and two neutrons.
118.example: Tritium contains one proton and two neutrons in its nucleus.

118.english_meaning: Nuclides having the same mass number A but different atomic numbers Z.
118.example: The nuclides 3-H-1 and 3-He-2 are examples of isobars.

118.english_meaning: Nuclides with the same neutron number N but different atomic numbers Z.
118.example: Mercury and gold can have nuclides that are isotones of each other.

118.english_meaning: A species of an atom characterized by its mass number and atomic number.
118.example: All nuclides with the same mass number A are called isobars.

118.english_meaning: A person who is among the first to explore or settle a new subject or area.
118.example: Rutherford was the pioneer who established the existence of the atomic nucleus.

118.english_meaning: Suggested or assumed something as true as the basis for reasoning, discussion, or belief.
118.example: Rutherford postulated and established the existence of the atomic nucleus.

118.english_meaning: The deflection of a wave or particle passing through a medium of nonuniformities.
118.example: The scattering of alpha particles from thin gold foils revealed crucial atomic structures.

118.english_meaning: Relating to electrostatic forces between electrically charged particles.
118.example: The coulomb repulsive force was solely responsible for the scattering.

118.english_meaning: Objects propelled with a force, in physics often referring to particles directed at a target.
118.example: Fast electrons were used as projectiles to bombard targets made of various elements.

118.english_meaning: To subject a target to a stream of high-energy particles or radiation.
118.example: Scientists bombard targets with fast electrons to measure nuclear sizes.

118.english_meaning: The action of departing from an established course or standard calculation.
118.example: From the distance at which deviations set in, nuclear sizes can be inferred.

118.english_meaning: Corresponding in size or amount to something else.
118.example: The volume of the nucleus is proportional to the mass number A.

119.english_meaning: The density of the matter making up the atomic nucleus, typically extremely high.
119.hindi_meaning: परमाणु के नाभिक के द्रव्यमान और आयतन का घनत्व (नाभिकीय घनत्व)
119.example: The nuclear density of an iron nucleus is calculated using its mass and volume.

119.english_meaning: Relating to astrophysics, the branch of astronomy concerned with the physical nature of stars and other celestial bodies.
119.example: Neutron stars are fascinating astrophysical objects studied by scientists.

119.english_meaning: Flattened by pressure; squeezed or pressed together.
119.example: Matter in neutron stars has been compressed to an extraordinary extent.

119.english_meaning: Albert Einstein's theory regarding the relationship between space, time, and energy.
119.hindi_meaning: सापेक्षता (अल्बर्ट आइंस्टीन का सापेक्षता का सिद्धांत)
119.example: Einstein's theory of special relativity changed our understanding of mass and energy.

119.english_meaning: Supposed that something is true on the basis of probability.
119.example: Before the new theory, it was presumed that mass and energy were conserved separately.

119.english_meaning: Kept or protected from waste, loss, or change; in physics, remaining constant during a process.
119.example: Energy and momentum are conserved quantities in an isolated system.

119.english_meaning: The condition of being equal or interchangeable in value, meaning, function, or effect.
119.example: Einstein's mass-energy equivalence equation is E = mc².

119.english_meaning: Very large in size, quantity, or extent.
119.example: Converting a small amount of matter to energy results in the release of an enormous amount of energy.

119.english_meaning: The process of establishing the truth, accuracy, or validity of something.
119.example: Experimental verification of the mass-energy relation was achieved through nuclear reactions.

119.english_meaning: A proton or a neutron, considered collectively as components of an atomic nucleus.
119.example: Nuclear reactions take place among nucleons and nuclei.

119.english_meaning: The principle by which the total value of a physical quantity remains constant in a system.
119.example: The conservation law of energy applies when mass-energy is taken into account.

119.english_meaning: Reciprocal action or influence between objects, particles, or systems.
119.example: The interaction of nuclei with one another determines nuclear properties.

119.english_meaning: Single; separate; existing as a distinct entity.
119.example: The mass of a nucleus differs from the total mass of its individual protons and neutrons.

119.english_meaning: A particular kind of matter with uniform properties.
119.example: Calculate the energy equivalent of 1 g of substance.

119.english_meaning: Set free, discharged, or emitted from a source.
119.example: Energy is released during nuclear fission and fusion reactions.

120.english_meaning: The plural form of nucleus, the positively charged central core of an atom, consisting of protons and neutrons.
120.hindi_meaning: नाभिक (परमाणु का केंद्र, जो प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन से मिलकर बनता है)
120.example: The properties of atomic nuclei are studied in nuclear physics.

120.english_meaning: Subatomic particles found in the nucleus of an atom that have a neutral charge and a mass nearly equal to that of a proton.
120.hindi_meaning: न्यूट्रॉन (परमाणु के नाभिक में पाया जाने वाला अनावेशित कण)
120.example: An oxygen-16 nucleus contains 8 protons and 8 neutrons.

120.english_meaning: Subatomic particles with a positive electric charge, found in the nucleus of every atom.
120.example: The number of protons determines the atomic number of an element.

120.english_meaning: The branch of science concerned with the investigation and measurement of spectra produced when matter interacts with or emits electromagnetic radiation.
120.hindi_meaning: स्पेक्ट्रोस्कोपी (पदार्थ और विकिरण के अध्ययन की वैज्ञानिक विधि)
120.example: Atomic mass is measured accurately using mass spectroscopy experiments.

120.english_meaning: The parts, components, or elements that make up a whole system or substance.
120.hindi_meaning: घटक या अवयव (किसी वस्तु को बनाने वाले भाग)
120.example: Protons and neutrons are the constituents of an atomic nucleus.

120.english_meaning: The difference between the mass of an atomic nucleus and the sum of the individual masses of its constituent protons and neutrons.
120.hindi_meaning: द्रव्यमान क्षति (नाभिक के वास्तविक द्रव्यमान और उसके घटकों के द्रव्यमान का अंतर)
120.example: The mass defect accounts for the binding energy holding the nucleus together.

120.english_meaning: The condition of being equal or interchangeable in value, meaning, function, or effect.
120.example: Einstein's principle establishes the equivalence of mass and energy.

120.english_meaning: Not tied up, fastened, or confined; existing separately without being linked or bound in a system.
120.hindi_meaning: मुक्त या स्वतंत्र (जो बंधा हुआ न हो)
120.example: In the unbound state, nucleons exist separately from one another.

120.english_meaning: Equal in value, amount, function, meaning, or potential.
120.example: One atomic mass unit is equivalent to 931.5 MeV of energy.

120.english_meaning: Provided or made available for use.
120.hindi_meaning: प्रदान किया गया या उपलब्ध कराया गया
120.example: Extra energy must be supplied to break the nucleus apart.

120.english_meaning: The energy required to split a nucleus of an atom into its component parts.
120.hindi_meaning: बंधन ऊर्जा (नाभिक को उसके घटकों में तोड़ने के लिए आवश्यक ऊर्जा)
120.example: The binding energy keeps the protons and neutrons tightly packed inside the nucleus.

120.english_meaning: A unit of mass used for expressing atomic and molecular weights, denoted as 'u'.
120.example: One atomic mass unit is equal to one-twelfth of the mass of an unbound carbon-12 atom.

120.english_meaning: The SI unit of work or energy.
120.hindi_meaning: जूल (कार्य या ऊर्जा का एस.आई. मात्रक)
120.example: Energy can be measured in joules or electron-volts.

120.english_meaning: Set free or emitted from a source or state.
120.hindi_meaning: मुक्त किया गया या उत्सर्जित किया गया
120.example: Energy is released when nucleons combine to form a stable nucleus.

120.english_meaning: To cause to move or be apart from each other.
120.example: Energy is required to separate the oxygen nucleus into its constituents.

121.english_meaning: The energy required to split a nucleus of an atom into its component protons and neutrons.
121.hindi_meaning: बंधन ऊर्जा - वह ऊर्जा जो किसी नाभिक को उसके न्यूक्लियॉन्स में अलग करने के लिए आवश्यक होती है।
121.example: The energy Eb is called the binding energy of the nucleus.

121.english_meaning: The positively charged central core of an atom, consisting of protons and neutrons.
121.hindi_meaning: नाभिक - परमाणु का केंद्रीय भाग जिसमें प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन होते हैं।
121.example: If we separate a nucleus into its nucleons, we would have to supply a total energy.

121.english_meaning: A proton or a neutron, considered collectively as constituents of the atomic nucleus.
121.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लियॉन - परमाणु के नाभिक में मौजूद प्रोटॉन या न्यूट्रॉन कण।
121.example: We can think of binding energy per nucleon as the average energy needed to separate a nucleus.

121.english_meaning: The parts, components, or elements that combine to make something up.
121.hindi_meaning: घटक - किसी वस्तु या पदार्थ को बनाने वाले भाग या अवयव।
121.example: A more useful measure of the binding between the constituents of the nucleus.

121.english_meaning: The total number of protons and neutrons in an atomic nucleus.
121.hindi_meaning: द्रव्यमान संख्या - किसी परमाणु के नाभिक में प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन की कुल संख्या।
121.example: Figure 13.1 is a plot of the binding energy per nucleon versus the mass number A.

121.english_meaning: The number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.
121.hindi_meaning: परमाणु क्रमांक - किसी परमाणु के नाभिक में मौजूद प्रोटॉनों की संख्या।
121.example: The binding energy per nucleon is practically independent of the atomic number.

121.english_meaning: The quality of staying the same, without change or variation.
121.hindi_meaning: स्थिरता - किसी स्थिति या मान का अपरिवर्तित बने रहना।
121.example: The constancy of the binding energy in the range 30 < A < 170 is a consequence of short-ranged nuclear forces.

121.english_meaning: A result or effect of an action or condition.
121.hindi_meaning: परिणाम - किसी घटना या स्थिति का नतीजा।
121.example: This phenomenon is a consequence of the fact that the nuclear force is short-ranged.

121.english_meaning: Acting or effective only over a very short distance.
121.hindi_meaning: अल्प-परास - जो केवल बहुत कम दूरी तक ही प्रभावी हो।
121.example: The nuclear force is short-ranged and affects only immediate neighbors.

121.english_meaning: Corresponding in size or amount to something else.
121.hindi_meaning: समानुपाती - जो किसी अन्य मात्रा के अनुपात में बदलता हो।
121.example: Its binding energy would be proportional to the number of neighbors p.

121.english_meaning: To have one's permanent home or to exist in a particular place.
121.hindi_meaning: निстаित होना / रहना - किसी स्थान पर स्थित होना।
121.example: Most of the nucleons in a large nucleus reside inside it and not on the surface.

121.english_meaning: To a degree that is enough or adequate.
121.hindi_meaning: पर्याप्त रूप से - इतनी मात्रा में जो पर्याप्त हो।
121.example: The force is attractive and sufficiently strong to produce a binding energy.

121.english_meaning: The capacity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone or something.
121.hindi_meaning: प्रभाव - किसी वस्तु या स्थिति पर असर डालने की क्षमता।
121.example: It will be under the influence of only some of its neighbors.

121.english_meaning: Free from outside control; not influenced or affected by something else.
121.hindi_meaning: स्वतंत्र - जो किसी अन्य कारक से प्रभावित न हो।
121.example: The value is practically independent of the atomic number for nuclei of middle mass number.

121.english_meaning: The action or process of closely observing something or someone, or a statement based on this.
121.hindi_meaning: अवलोकन - किसी तथ्य को ध्यानपूर्वक देखने या परखने से प्राप्त निष्कर्ष।
121.example: We can draw some conclusions from these two observations.

122.english_meaning: The subatomic particles that make up the nucleus of an atom, specifically protons and neutrons.
122.hindi_meaning: परमाणु के नाभिक में स्थित कण (प्रोटॉन और न्यूट्रॉन)।
122.example: The nuclear force acts between nucleons to keep the nucleus stable.

122.english_meaning: The state or process that occurs when no more of something can be absorbed, combined with, or added.
122.hindi_meaning: संतृप्ति; वह अवस्था जब और अधिक समाहित न किया जा सके।
122.example: The saturation of nuclear forces explains why binding energy per nucleon remains constant.

122.english_meaning: The action of dividing or splitting something into two or more parts, specifically a heavy nucleus.
122.hindi_meaning: विखंडन; एक भारी नाभिक का दो हल्के नाभिकों में टूटना।
122.example: Energy is released during the process of nuclear fission.

122.english_meaning: The process or result of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.
122.hindi_meaning: संलयन; दो हल्के नाभिकों का जुड़कर एक भारी नाभिक बनाना।
122.example: Nuclear fusion is the primary energy source of the sun.

122.english_meaning: The electrostatic force of attraction or repulsion between two charged particles.
122.hindi_meaning: स्थिर-वैद्युत बल; आवेशित कणों के बीच लगने वाला आकर्षण या प्रतिकर्षण बल।
122.example: The Coulomb force causes repulsion between positively charged protons.

122.english_meaning: The energy required to disassemble a nucleus into its constituent protons and neutrons.
122.hindi_meaning: बंधन ऊर्जा; नाभिक को उसके घटकों में अलग करने के लिए आवश्यक ऊर्जा।
122.example: Higher binding energy per nucleon indicates a more stable nucleus.

122.english_meaning: A force that pushes two objects away from each other.
122.hindi_meaning: प्रतिकर्षण; दो वस्तुओं को एक-दूसरे से दूर धकेलने वाला बल।
122.example: The electrostatic repulsion between protons must be overcome by the nuclear force.

122.english_meaning: The quality of being unchanging or dependable.
122.example: The constancy of binding energy per nucleon is a key feature of nuclear physics.

122.english_meaning: A unit of length equal to 10^-15 meters, often used in nuclear physics.
122.hindi_meaning: फेम्टोमीटर; लंबाई की एक इकाई (10^-15 मीटर)।
122.example: Nuclear forces act only over a distance of a few femtometres.

122.english_meaning: The energy held by an object because of its position relative to other objects.
122.hindi_meaning: स्थितिज ऊर्जा; किसी वस्तु की स्थिति के कारण उसमें संचित ऊर्जा।
122.example: The potential energy between two nucleons depends on their separation distance.

122.english_meaning: Relating to the force that attracts a body toward the center of the earth or toward any other physical body having mass.
122.hindi_meaning: गुरुत्वाकर्षण संबंधी; द्रव्यमान वाली वस्तुओं के बीच लगने वाला आकर्षण बल।
122.example: Gravitational force is much weaker than the nuclear force.

122.english_meaning: To have a commanding influence on; exercise control over.
122.hindi_meaning: हावी होना; नियंत्रण रखना या प्रभावी होना।
122.example: The nuclear force must dominate over the Coulomb repulsive force.

122.english_meaning: Being a part of a whole.
122.hindi_meaning: घटक; किसी संपूर्ण वस्तु का एक भाग।
122.example: Protons and neutrons are the constituents of an atomic nucleus.

122.english_meaning: Causing to come near or adhere.
122.example: The nuclear force is strongly attractive at short ranges.

122.english_meaning: The conclusion that can be drawn from something, although it is not explicitly stated.
122.hindi_meaning: निहितार्थ; किसी बात से निकलने वाला परिणाम या अर्थ।

146.hindi_meaning: देहली (वह न्यूनतम स्तर जिस पर कोई क्रिया शुरू होती है)
146.example: The threshold voltage for a silicon diode is approximately 0.7 volts.

146.english_meaning: A chemical element used as a semiconductor material.
146.hindi_meaning: जर्मेनियम (एक रासायनिक तत्व जो अर्धचालक के रूप में उपयोग होता है)

146.english_meaning: The process of converting alternating current (AC) into direct current (DC).
146.hindi_meaning: दिष्टकरण (प्रत्यावर्ती धारा को दिष्ट धारा में बदलने की प्रक्रिया)
146.example: Diodes are essential components for the rectification of AC voltages.

146.english_meaning: Relating to energy or objects in motion; constantly changing.
146.hindi_meaning: गतिक (जो निरंतर बदलता रहता है या गति में है)

146.english_meaning: A point where two or more things are joined.

146.english_meaning: The refusal to accept or comply with something; in physics, the opposition to current flow.
146.hindi_meaning: प्रतिरोध (विद्युत धारा के प्रवाह में आने वाली बाधा)

146.english_meaning: The point or place where something begins or is derived.
146.hindi_meaning: मूल बिंदु (ग्राफ पर वह बिंदु जहाँ अक्ष मिलते हैं)

146.hindi_meaning: भंजन (वह स्थिति जहाँ विद्युत रोधन क्षमता समाप्त हो जाती है)
146.example: The current increases suddenly when the voltage exceeds the breakdown voltage.

146.english_meaning: An amount or number of something.
146.hindi_meaning: राशि (किसी चीज की मात्रा या संख्या)

147.english_meaning: A semiconductor device with a p-n junction that allows current to flow in only one direction.
147.hindi_meaning: एक अर्धचालक उपकरण जिसमें p-n जंक्शन होता है जो धारा को केवल एक दिशा में प्रवाहित होने देता है।
147.example: The junction diode acts as a one-way valve for electric current.

147.english_meaning: An electrical device that converts alternating current (AC) into direct current (DC).
147.hindi_meaning: एक विद्युत उपकरण जो प्रत्यावर्ती धारा (AC) को दिष्ट धारा (DC) में परिवर्तित करता है।
147.example: A rectifier is essential for charging batteries using AC power.

147.english_meaning: The state of a diode when the positive terminal is connected to the p-side, allowing current to flow.
147.hindi_meaning: डायोड की वह अवस्था जब धनात्मक टर्मिनल p-सिरे से जुड़ा होता है, जिससे धारा प्रवाहित होती है।
147.example: The diode conducts electricity only when it is forward biased.

147.english_meaning: Voltage that periodically reverses direction and changes its magnitude over time.
147.hindi_meaning: वह वोल्टेज जो समय के साथ अपनी दिशा और परिमाण को आवर्ती रूप से बदलता रहता है।
147.example: The transformer converts the alternating voltage to a lower level.

147.english_meaning: Varying in intensity or magnitude in a rhythmic or periodic way.
147.hindi_meaning: जो लयबद्ध या आवर्ती रूप से तीव्रता या परिमाण में बदलता रहता है।
147.example: The output of the half-wave rectifier is a pulsating voltage.

147.english_meaning: The output coil of a transformer that receives energy through electromagnetic induction.
147.hindi_meaning: ट्रांसफार्मर की वह कुंडली जो विद्युत चुंबकीय प्रेरण के माध्यम से ऊर्जा प्राप्त करती है।
147.example: The secondary of the transformer supplies the required voltage.

147.english_meaning: The state of a diode where it blocks current flow because the voltage is applied in the opposite direction.
147.hindi_meaning: डायोड की वह अवस्था जहाँ यह धारा के प्रवाह को रोकता है क्योंकि वोल्टेज विपरीत दिशा में लगाया जाता है।
147.example: When the diode is reverse-biased, it acts as an open circuit.

147.english_meaning: The state or process that occurs when no more of something can be absorbed or added.
147.hindi_meaning: वह अवस्था या प्रक्रिया जब और अधिक कुछ भी अवशोषित या जोड़ा नहीं जा सकता।
147.example: The reverse saturation current in a diode is typically very small.

147.english_meaning: So small or unimportant as to be not worth considering.
147.hindi_meaning: इतना कम या महत्वहीन कि उस पर ध्यान देने की आवश्यकता न हो।
147.example: The error in the measurement was negligible.

147.english_meaning: The minimum reverse voltage that causes a diode to conduct significantly in the reverse direction.
147.hindi_meaning: वह न्यूनतम विपरीत वोल्टेज जिस पर डायोड विपरीत दिशा में महत्वपूर्ण रूप से धारा प्रवाहित करने लगता है।
147.example: Exceeding the breakdown voltage can damage the diode.

147.english_meaning: A component of an electrical circuit that resists the flow of electric current.
147.hindi_meaning: विद्युत परिपथ का एक घटक जो विद्युत धारा के प्रवाह का विरोध करता है।
147.example: The load resistor limits the current in the circuit.

147.english_meaning: A visual representation of the shape and form of a signal or wave.
147.hindi_meaning: किसी संकेत या तरंग के आकार और रूप का दृश्य निरूपण।
147.example: The oscilloscope displayed the output voltage waveform.

147.english_meaning: A connection made at the midpoint of a transformer's secondary winding.
147.hindi_meaning: ट्रांसफार्मर की सेकेंडरी वाइंडिंग के मध्य बिंदु पर किया गया एक कनेक्शन।
147.example: A centre tapping allows the transformer to provide two equal voltages.

147.english_meaning: A typical or noticeable quality or feature of something.
147.hindi_meaning: किसी वस्तु का विशिष्ट गुण या विशेषता।
147.example: The V-I characteristic curve shows how current changes with voltage.

147.english_meaning: A point of connection for closing an electric circuit.
147.hindi_meaning: विद्युत परिपथ को पूरा करने के लिए कनेक्शन का एक बिंदु।
147.example: Connect the wires to the positive and negative terminals.

148.english_meaning: A material that has electrical conductivity between that of a conductor and an insulator.
148.hindi_meaning: अर्धचालक (वह पदार्थ जिसकी विद्युत चालकता चालक और कुचालक के बीच होती है)
148.example: Silicon is the most commonly used semiconductor in electronic devices.

148.english_meaning: An electrical device that converts alternating current (AC) into direct current (DC).
148.hindi_meaning: दिष्टकारी (वह उपकरण जो प्रत्यावर्ती धारा को दिष्ट धारा में बदलता है)
148.example: A full-wave rectifier is more efficient than a half-wave rectifier.

148.english_meaning: In electronics, the application of a voltage to a diode or transistor to control its operation.
148.hindi_meaning: अभिनत (इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स में, डायोड या ट्रांजिस्टर के संचालन को नियंत्रित करने के लिए वोल्टेज का अनुप्रयोग)
148.example: The diode is forward biased when the positive terminal is connected to the p-side.

148.english_meaning: Moving or operating in a single direction only.
148.hindi_meaning: एकदिशीय (केवल एक ही दिशा में चलने वाला)
148.example: The current flowing through the diode is unidirectional.

148.english_meaning: A curve representing periodic oscillations, such as a sine wave.
148.hindi_meaning: ज्या-वक्र (एक वक्र जो आवर्ती दोलनों को दर्शाता है)
148.example: The output voltage pulses are in the shape of half sinusoids.

148.english_meaning: A device used to store an electric charge, consisting of one or more pairs of conductors separated by an insulator.
148.hindi_meaning: संधारित्र (विद्युत आवेश को संचित करने वाला उपकरण)
148.example: A capacitor is used in the circuit to filter out the AC ripple.

148.english_meaning: A component in an electrical circuit that stores energy in a magnetic field when electric current flows through it.
148.hindi_meaning: प्रेरक (विद्युत परिपथ का एक घटक जो चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में ऊर्जा संचित करता है)
148.example: An inductor can be used in series with the load to smooth the output current.

148.english_meaning: Small, unwanted fluctuations in a direct current voltage which is the output of a power supply.
148.hindi_meaning: तरंगिका (दिष्ट धारा में होने वाले छोटे अवांछित उतार-चढ़ाव)
148.example: Filters are used to remove the AC ripple from the rectified output.

148.english_meaning: In a manner that is opposite or contrary in position, direction, or effect.
148.example: The rate of voltage fall depends inversely upon the product of capacitance and resistance.

148.english_meaning: The ability of a system to store an electric charge.
148.hindi_meaning: धारिता (किसी निकाय की विद्युत आवेश संचित करने की क्षमता)
148.example: Increasing the capacitance helps in maintaining a steady output voltage.

148.english_meaning: Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.
148.hindi_meaning: दक्ष / कुशल (कम बर्बादी के साथ अधिकतम परिणाम देने वाला)
148.example: This circuit is more efficient for rectifying voltage than the half-wave rectifier.

148.english_meaning: Expanding and contracting or varying in intensity rhythmically.
148.hindi_meaning: स्पंदमान (जो लयबद्ध तरीके से घटता-बढ़ता हो)
148.example: The rectifier produces a pulsating DC output.

148.english_meaning: A point of connection for closing an electric circuit.
148.hindi_meaning: सिरा / टर्मिनल (विद्युत परिपथ को जोड़ने का बिंदु)
148.example: Connect the load resistor across the output terminals.

148.english_meaning: A value or number that does not change.
148.hindi_meaning: नियतांक (वह मान जो बदलता नहीं है)
148.example: The time constant determines how quickly the capacitor discharges.

148.english_meaning: The position of a point in time on a waveform cycle.
148.hindi_meaning: कला (तरंग के चक्र में समय की स्थिति)
148.example: The voltages at A and B are out of phase with each other.

149.english_meaning: An electrical device that converts alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).
149.hindi_meaning: दिष्टकारी (एक उपकरण जो प्रत्यावर्ती धारा को दृष्ट धारा में बदलता है)
149.example: A full-wave rectifier uses diodes to convert AC voltage into DC voltage.

149.english_meaning: A device used to store an electrical charge in an electric field.
149.hindi_meaning: संधारित्र (विद्युत आवेश को संचित करने वाला उपकरण)
149.example: The capacitor filter helps to smooth out the output voltage of the rectifier.

149.english_meaning: A solid substance that has a conductivity between that of an insulator and that of most metals.
149.hindi_meaning: अर्धचालक (वह पदार्थ जिसकी विद्युत चालकता कुचालक और सुचालक के बीच होती है)
149.example: Silicon is the most widely used semiconductor in electronic devices.

149.english_meaning: A measure of the resisting power of a specified material to the flow of an electric current.
149.hindi_meaning: प्रतिरोधकता (किसी पदार्थ की विद्युत धारा के प्रवाह को रोकने की क्षमता का माप)
149.example: Metals have very low resistivity compared to insulators.

149.english_meaning: Belonging to a thing by its very nature; pure semiconductor without impurities.
149.hindi_meaning: नैज / शुद्ध (बिना किसी अशुद्धि के शुद्ध अर्धचालक)
149.example: Pure germanium is an example of an intrinsic semiconductor.

149.english_meaning: Relating to or caused by heat.
149.example: Thermal excitation creates electron-hole pairs in semiconductors.

149.english_meaning: The addition of energy to a system, causing a transition from one energy level to a higher one.
149.hindi_meaning: उत्तेजन (ऊर्जा पाकर उच्च स्तर पर जाना)
149.example: Thermal excitation promotes electrons from the valence band to the conduction band.

149.english_meaning: An unoccupied space or position, referring to an empty electron state (hole) in physics.
149.hindi_meaning: रिक्तिका / खाली स्थान (इलेक्ट्रॉन की अनुपस्थिति या होल)
149.example: A hole acts as an electron vacancy with an effective positive charge.

149.english_meaning: The intentional introduction of impurities into an intrinsic semiconductor to modify its electrical properties.
149.example: Doping pure silicon with boron creates a p-type semiconductor.

149.english_meaning: Relating to a semiconductor doped with impurity atoms.
149.example: Extrinsic semiconductors are classified into n-type and p-type.
Phosphorus is a pentavalent impurity used to make n-type semiconductors.
Aluminium is a trivalent atom used as an acceptor in doping.

149.english_meaning: Relating to the outer electrons of an atom that can participate in chemical bonding or conduction bands.
149.hindi_meaning: संयोजी (परमाणु का बाहरी हिस्सा जो बंधन बनाता है)
149.example: All energy levels in the valence band are completely filled at absolute zero.

149.english_meaning: The transmission of heat or electricity through a medium.
149.example: Free electrons in the conduction band are responsible for electric current.

149.english_meaning: The state of being neutral, having no net electrical charge.
149.example: Despite doping, the semiconductor material maintains overall charge neutrality.

150.english_meaning: A solid substance that has a conductivity between that of an insulator and that of most metals, either due to the addition of an impurity or because of temperature effects.
150.hindi_meaning: अर्धचालक (एक ऐसा पदार्थ जिसकी विद्युत चालकता कुचालक और सुचालक के बीच होती है)
150.example: Silicon is the most commonly used semiconductor in electronic devices.

150.english_meaning: The range of electron energy values sufficient to make the electrons free to move within the solid, thus acting as charge carriers to conduct electric current.
150.hindi_meaning: चालन बैंड (ऊर्जा बैंड जो इलेक्ट्रॉनों को स्वतंत्र रूप से गति करने और धारा प्रवाहित करने की अनुमति देता है)
150.example: Thermal energy can excite electrons from the valence band to the conduction band.

150.english_meaning: A substance which does not readily allow the passage of heat or sound, and notably electricity.
150.hindi_meaning: कुचालक (वह पदार्थ जो अपने अंदर से विद्युत धारा प्रवाहित नहीं होने देता)
150.example: Glass and plastic are good electrical insulators.

150.english_meaning: A region within a p-n junction semiconductor where mobile charge carriers have diffused away, leaving behind immobile charged ions.
150.hindi_meaning: अवक्षय परत (p-n संधि के पास की वह क्षेत्र जहाँ आवेश वाहक समाप्त हो जाते हैं)
150.example: The width of the depletion layer changes when an external voltage is applied.

150.english_meaning: An energy barrier that prevents the diffusion of charge carriers across a p-n junction without an applied external voltage.
150.hindi_meaning: विभव प्राचीर (वह आंतरिक विद्युत अवरोध जो आवेशों के प्रवाह को रोकता है)
150.example: Forward bias reduces the potential barrier of the p-n junction diode.

150.english_meaning: A voltage applied across a p-n junction that reduces the potential barrier and allows a large electric current to flow easily.
150.hindi_meaning: अग्र अभिनति (वह स्थिति जिसमें p-n संधि पर ऐसा बाहरी वोल्टेज लगाया जाता है जिससे धारा आसानी से बहे)
150.example: In forward bias, the positive terminal of the battery is connected to the p-side.

150.english_meaning: A voltage applied across a p-n junction in the opposite direction, which increases the potential barrier and restricts current flow.
150.hindi_meaning: पश्च अभिनति (वह स्थिति जिसमें संधि का अवरोध बढ़ जाता है और नगण्य धारा बहती है)
150.example: The reverse bias current in a diode is extremely small.

150.english_meaning: Converting alternating current (ac) to direct current (dc).
150.hindi_meaning: दिष्टकरण (प्रत्यावर्ती धारा यानी ac को दिष्ट धारा यानी dc में बदलना)
150.example: Diodes are commonly used for rectifying an ac voltage into a dc voltage.

150.english_meaning: A device used to store an electric charge, consisting of one or more pairs of conductors separated by an insulator.
150.hindi_meaning: संधारित्र (विद्युत ऊर्जा को संग्रहित करने वाला उपकरण)
150.example: A capacitor is used along with a diode to obtain a smooth dc voltage.

150.english_meaning: Not localized or confined to a specific point or region, but spread over a larger area or system.
150.hindi_meaning: विस्थानीकृत (जो किसी एक निश्चित स्थान पर सीमित न होकर पूरे क्षेत्र में फैला हो)
150.example: Energy bands in semiconductors are space delocalised.

150.english_meaning: The energy band containing the valence electrons that are bound to specific atoms and are not normally free to move.
150.hindi_meaning: संयोजी बैंड (वह ऊर्जा स्तर जिसमें संयोजी इलेक्ट्रॉन बंधे होते हैं)
150.example: At absolute zero, the valence band is completely filled with electrons.

150.english_meaning: Impurity atoms added in small amounts to an intrinsic semiconductor to alter its electrical properties.
150.hindi_meaning: अपमिश्रक (अर्धचालक की चालकता बढ़ाने के लिए मिलाए जाने वाले अशुद्धता परमाणु)
150.example: Pentavalent and trivalent elements are used as dopants in silicon.

150.english_meaning: Relating to the numerical relationship between reactants and products in a chemical reaction or the fixed ratio of elements in a compound.
150.hindi_meaning: स्टोइकोमीट्रिक (यौगिकों में तत्वों का निश्चित रासायनिक अनुपात)
150.example: In an ideal GaAs compound, the stoichiometric ratio of Ga to As is 1:1.

150.english_meaning: Having a valence of three, meaning an atom with three electrons in its outermost shell.
150.hindi_meaning: त्रिंसयोजी (वह परमाणु जिसकी बाहरी कक्षा में तीन इलेक्ट्रॉन होते हैं)
150.example: Boron and indium are examples of trivalent dopants used to create p-type semiconductors.

150.english_meaning: Having a valence of five, meaning an atom with five electrons in its outermost shell.
150.hindi_meaning: पंचसंयोजी (वह परमाणु जिसकी बाहरी कक्षा में पाँच इलेक्ट्रॉन होते हैं)
150.example: Phosphorus and arsenic are pentavalent atoms used to form n-type semiconductors.

151.english_meaning: The energy range in a solid where no electron states can exist, lying between the conduction band and valence band.
151.hindi_meaning: ऊर्जा अंतराल (वह ऊर्जा क्षेत्र जिसमें कोई इलेक्ट्रॉन नहीं रह सकता)
151.example: The energy band gap determines whether a material is a conductor, semiconductor, or insulator.

151.english_meaning: Not connected to any external voltage source.
151.hindi_meaning: अभिनति रहित / जिस पर कोई बाहरी वोल्टेज न लगा हो
151.example: In an unbiased p-n junction, no external battery is connected.

151.english_meaning: A boundary or interface between two types of semiconductor material, p-type and n-type, inside a single crystal of semiconductor.
151.example: A p-n junction forms the basic building block of semiconductor diodes.

151.english_meaning: The absence of an electron in a particular place in a crystal lattice, acting as a positive charge carrier.
151.example: Holes diffuse from the p-region to the n-region in a semiconductor.

151.english_meaning: To move or spread from a region of higher concentration to a region of lower concentration.
151.example: Charge carriers tend to diffuse across the junction due to concentration gradients.

151.english_meaning: The amount of a specified substance in a unit amount of another substance.
151.example: The hole concentration is much higher in the p-region than in the n-region.

151.english_meaning: A voltage applied to a p-n junction that reduces the potential barrier and allows current to flow easily.
151.example: When a forward bias is applied, the width of the depletion region decreases.

151.english_meaning: An energy barrier that prevents the diffusion of charge carriers across a p-n junction in the absence of external voltage.
151.example: Applying a forward bias lowers the potential barrier of the junction.

151.english_meaning: The type of charge carrier (electrons or holes) that constitutes the greater number in a semiconductor.
151.example: Majority carrier current increases significantly under forward bias.

151.english_meaning: The conversion of an alternating current (AC) into a direct current (DC).
151.hindi_meaning: दिष्टकरण (प्रत्यावर्ती धारा को दिष्ट धारा में बदलना)
151.example: Diodes are commonly used for the rectification of alternating current.

151.english_meaning: The frequency of the signal produced at the output terminal of a device or circuit.
151.example: In half-wave rectification, the output frequency is equal to the input frequency.

151.english_meaning: An electronic circuit that converts both halves of an alternating current cycle into pulsating direct current.
151.example: A full-wave rectifier utilizes both halves of the input AC cycle.

151.english_meaning: A solid substance that has a conductivity between that of an insulator and that of most metals.
151.example: Silicon and germanium are widely used semiconductor materials.

151.english_meaning: A definite or clear expression of something in speech or writing.
151.example: Read the question carefully and determine which of the following statements is true.

151.english_meaning: To evoke a physical reaction of pulling towards itself.
151.example: Opposite charges attract each other in an electric field.
